messages:
elaine: FYI customer reported intermittent 410s from /v1/webhook after shim changes. Can docs coordinate a short deprecation notice + migration guide?

sam: I can draft. Proposal: announce start today, 30-day soft-redirect, full removal 2025-07-15. Include SDK snippet changes and changelog blurb.

maya: please add a quickstart for the v2 signed webhook (auth header -> Bearer + X-Webhook-Signature). Also add a minimal smoketest in docs CI.

kevin: SDK impact: add verifyWebhookSignature helper across libs. Example JS helper I can push.

sam: PR plan: top-level deprecation note, migration guide, JS/Python examples, redirect in docs config. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1854

docs-ci-bot: lint check queued for PR 1854.

maya: adding a tiny example app under examples/webhooks and a README. Local test snippet for signatures included.

elaine: include token rotation curl example and troubleshooting table (401: check Bearer, 400: signature mismatch, 410: endpoint removed).

sam: aiming to merge tomorrow EOD if CI green. I'll announce after merge.

kevin: SDK PRs will land before noon tomorrow, will reference migration guide.

maya: merging branch `webhook/v2-migration` into docs draft. Preview: https://deploy-preview-1854--docs.redwood.ai/webhook-migration

elaine: I'll file an internal ticket for platform to enable 30-day redirect behavior after merge.

sam: final checklist: responsive snippets, signature helpers, smoke tests green, redirect mapping, release note. Once green I merge and we post announcement. :rocket:
